CustomField.label: Surface-Gated Detectors
CustomField.description: Phase 24z-C — Serialized JSON list of detector IDs that were skipped during this scan because their RequiredSurface__c SObjects were not present on the target org (e.g. ARM-001 skipped when ProductSellingModel doesn't exist on a vanilla DE org). Surfaces the previously-silent gating decision so consultants can confirm "those detectors weren't run, this score reflects only what's installed" rather than wonder whether they passed.
